scene: Kitchen nook after an outing. Mom sits at screen-left; Child stands beside the table at screen-right with his hands resting on the table edge. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child recounts the day with happy energy; Mom reacts with warm interest and one soft laugh; the ending is cozy and amused.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.end: Child's palm rests on the table; Mom listens attentively.
